Defines Solana runtime binary types and fd_bincode encode/decode helpers.

# Purpose
This header file defines the binary data types that the runtime uses for Solana state, instructions, sysvars, and related records. It maps Rust and protocol objects such as `fd_vote_state`, `fd_stake_state_v2`, `fd_system_program_instruction`, `fd_bpf_upgradeable_loader_state`, and `fd_rent_state_t` to C structs and unions with fixed or dynamic encoded sizes. The file also declares helper functions for encode, decode, size, align, type checks, walk, and state inspection, so the codebase can read and write these values in `fd_bincode` format with correct memory layout. It includes versioned forms, discriminant-based unions, offset-based join and update helpers for dynamic fields, and include protection that ends with `#endif // HEADER_FD_RUNTIME_TYPES`.
